body:
Pass 9, correcting myself. In bd-01KZXEVFW3X074685EXWJZNP2D I said lowering cannot vary through any public path - that is only true of the effect-form path. measurement_form() takes reducer as a user-settable validated parameter, and aggregate_first vs reduce_partitions produce different stage_order and different receipts (numbers identical on a raw bilinear form, which is correct per contract section 12).

That is good news for Epic 4: measurement_form already shows the target shape, so you can copy it for the effect-form path and assert stage_order differences without waiting on 0A. The 0A dependency matters for the normalizer/transform axis only.

Still stands, re-verified: geometry/evaluate_geometry take no normalizer/transform/reducer, receipt at compiler.R:690-699 is a literal, .compile_effect_task has one call site whose entire return is a digest.

Narrowed 0A inventory: genuinely dead is 5 not 8 - correlation, cosine, covariance, fisher_z, rank_edges (only consumer .evaluate_edge_operation, tests only). Keep aggregate_first and reduce_partitions (live via measurement_form) and inner_product (pinned default). Details in the notes on 0A and C8.
